title: mail: RFC 8620 serde types (Request/Response/Invocation)
description:
Define serde types in crates/mail/src/jmap/types.rs: Request {using: Vec<String>, methodCalls: Vec<Invocation>, createdIds: Option<HashMap>}, Response {methodResponses: Vec<Invocation>, sessionState: String, createdIds: HashMap}, Invocation(method_name, args_json, call_id), standard error objects (unknownCapability, unknownMethod, notJSON, limit, forbidden, overQuota, notFound, invalidArguments, etc.).

Why: every JMAP method handler receives and returns these types; they must exist before any endpoint can be implemented.

Acceptance: unit test round-trips a minimal Request/Response through serde_json.
